name: Phishing
short_description: Tricking a person into opening a malicious message or link.
detection_tips: Mail gateway alerts, unusual child processes of mail clients.

name: Exploit Public-Facing Application
short_description: Abusing a flaw in an internet-facing service.
detection_tips: Web error spikes, unexpected processes under the web server.

name: Valid Accounts
short_description: Using stolen but genuine credentials to log in.
detection_tips: New device or country for the account, success after failures.

name: Cloud Accounts
short_description: Using stolen cloud identities or tokens.
detection_tips: Tokens used from outside the expected pipeline or region.

name: Command and Scripting Interpreter
short_description: Running commands through a shell or script engine.
detection_tips: Unusual parent processes and command lines.

name: PowerShell
short_description: Running malicious logic through PowerShell.
detection_tips: Encoded commands, hidden windows, script block logs.

name: Windows Command Shell
short_description: Running commands through cmd.exe.
detection_tips: cmd.exe spawned by services or office applications.

name: Scheduled Task/Job
short_description: Running code through a task scheduler.
detection_tips: New scheduled tasks created outside change windows.

name: Service Execution
short_description: Running a payload as a system service.
detection_tips: New services with odd binary paths, PsExec-like names.

name: Create Account
short_description: Creating a new account to keep access.
detection_tips: Account creation events outside normal provisioning.

name: Local Account
short_description: Creating a local account on one machine.
detection_tips: Local administrator group changes.

name: Account Manipulation
short_description: Changing an account's rights or credentials to keep access.
detection_tips: Group membership and credential changes.

name: Boot or Logon Autostart Execution
short_description: Setting code to start automatically.
detection_tips: Changes to run keys and startup folders.

name: Exploitation for Privilege Escalation
short_description: Abusing a software flaw to gain higher rights.
detection_tips: Crashes followed by a higher-privilege process.

name: Abuse Elevation Control Mechanism
short_description: Getting around controls that limit elevated rights.
detection_tips: Unusual sudo or UAC behaviour.

name: Obfuscated Files or Information
short_description: Hiding content through encoding or packing.
detection_tips: Long encoded arguments, high-entropy payloads.

name: Indicator Removal
short_description: Deleting logs or traces of activity.
detection_tips: Log clearing events, gaps in log streams.

name: Impair Defenses
short_description: Turning off or weakening security tools.
detection_tips: Security agents stopped, firewall rule changes.

name: OS Credential Dumping
short_description: Pulling credentials from system memory or files.
detection_tips: Access to LSASS, credential-dumping tool names.

name: Brute Force
short_description: Guessing passwords through repeated attempts.
detection_tips: Many failures for an account, then a success.

name: Password Guessing
short_description: Trying likely passwords on one account.
detection_tips: Repeated failures from one source.

name: Password Spraying
short_description: Trying one password across many accounts.
detection_tips: Few failures on each of many accounts.

name: Credential Stuffing
short_description: Trying credentials leaked from other breaches.
detection_tips: Many sources, many usernames, low success rate.

name: Remote System Discovery
short_description: Listing other machines on the network.
detection_tips: Internal hosts scanning peers.

name: Network Service Discovery
short_description: Scanning for open services.
detection_tips: Port scans from unapproved sources.

name: Account Discovery
short_description: Listing accounts and groups.
detection_tips: Bulk directory queries by ordinary users.

name: System Information Discovery
short_description: Collecting details about a system.
detection_tips: Inventory commands run in quick succession.

name: Remote Services
short_description: Moving between machines through remote services.
detection_tips: Remote logins between peers that rarely connect.

name: Remote Desktop Protocol
short_description: Moving through remote desktop sessions.
detection_tips: RDP from workstations to servers.

name: SMB/Windows Admin Shares
short_description: Moving through admin shares.
detection_tips: Writes to ADMIN$ followed by new services.

name: Data from Local System
short_description: Gathering files from a machine.
detection_tips: Bulk reads of sensitive directories.

name: Archive Collected Data
short_description: Packing data before stealing it.
detection_tips: Archive tools run on servers.

name: Application Layer Protocol
short_description: Hiding control traffic in normal protocols.
detection_tips: Regular beacons, unusual destinations.

name: DNS
short_description: Carrying control traffic inside DNS.
detection_tips: Long random subdomains, high query volume.

name: Ingress Tool Transfer
short_description: Bringing tools in from outside.
detection_tips: certutil or curl fetching executables.

name: Exfiltration Over Alternative Protocol
short_description: Stealing data over a protocol other than the control channel.
detection_tips: Large outbound transfers, especially at night.

name: Exfiltration Over C2 Channel
short_description: Stealing data over the control channel.
detection_tips: Outbound volume on a beaconing connection.

name: Exfiltration Over Web Service
short_description: Stealing data through a web service.
detection_tips: Uploads to file-sharing sites from servers.

name: Data Encrypted for Impact
short_description: Encrypting data to disrupt the business.
detection_tips: Mass file rewrites, ransom notes.

name: Service Stop
short_description: Stopping services to disrupt the business.
detection_tips: Many services stopped together.

name: Inhibit System Recovery
short_description: Removing backups to block recovery.
detection_tips: Shadow copy deletion.
